action: Rotate administrator and VPN credentials, especially on FortiGate appliances, and enforce multi-factor sign-in on all remote access. Audit for administrator accounts you did not create and patch edge devices quickly.
exec: Ransomware on industrial firms keeps rising and manufacturing bears most of it; remote access and edge devices are the common entry.
plain: Security firm Dragos counted 1,266 ransomware attacks on factories and other industrial companies in three months, 11% more than the previous quarter. Most began through remote-access equipment or stolen VPN passwords.

key_findings: Dragos tracked 1,266 ransomware incidents affecting industrial organisations in Q3 2026, up 11% from 1,140 in Q2.
Manufacturing accounted for 876 incidents (69%); North America had 566, of which 473 were in the United States.
Qilin claimed 195 victims and The Gentlemen 167; distinct ransomware brands hitting industry rose from 70 to 99.
Entry came through internet-facing edge devices and enterprise applications, often within days of disclosure, and stolen VPN credentials.
Cl0p returned with 35 victims via PTC Windchill and FlexPLM exploitation; no operator was seen manipulating a control system directly.
recommendations: Rotate administrator and VPN credentials, especially on FortiGate appliances.
Enforce MFA on all remote access.
Audit for administrator accounts you did not create.
Patch edge devices and enterprise applications rapidly and run continuous external attack surface management.
Enforce strict policies for remote monitoring and management tools.

summary: Dragos recorded 1,266 ransomware incidents affecting industrial organisations in the third quarter of 2026, up 11% from 1,140 the quarter before. Manufacturing took 69% of them and the United States 37%. According to Dragos, Qilin led with 195 incidents, ahead of The Gentlemen (167 claimed victims) and Cl0p (35). Attackers mostly entered through edge devices and stolen VPN credentials. Dragos saw no operator directly manipulate an industrial control system.
title: Dragos counts 1,266 ransomware incidents at industrial organisations in Q3 2026

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Dragos report.
